name: Monolith
description: A personal workspace for pages, projects, calendar and databases

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database (postgres), uploaded files and installed add-ons (storage) and this install's own keys (state/secrets.env). Back this folder up; the data can't be read without the keys.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Monolith web app and API, published on host as 6138

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The https address you open Monolith at, like https://monolith.example.com. Monolith only signs you in on https, or on http://localhost:6138 on the MOS box itself, so to use it from other devices put it behind a reverse proxy (or Tailscale) with https and type that address here.
